name: Yae Miko
mistakes: Bursting before all 3 Sesshou Sakura are placed: the Burst gets stronger with each one, and gives Skill charges back.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Spiritfox Sin-Eater
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Summons forth kitsune spirits, initiating a maximum of 3 attacks that deal Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path with thunderous might. Deals AoE Electro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Electro attacks, an Electro Charged Attack after a short cast, and an Electro plunge.

abilities.name: Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura
abilities.canon:
To Yae, such dull tasks as can be accomplished by driving spirits out need not be done personally.
Moves swiftly, leaving a Sesshou Sakura behind.

Sesshou Sakura
Has the following properties:
· Periodically strikes one nearby opponent with lightning, dealing Electro DMG
· When there are other Sesshou Sakura nearby, their level will increase, boosting the DMG dealt by these lightning strikes.

This skill has three charges.
A maximum of 3 Sesshou Sakura can exist simultaneously. The initial level of each Sesshou Sakura is 1, and the initial highest level each sakura can reach is 3. If a new Sesshou Sakura is created too close to an existing one, the existing one will be destroyed.
abilities.simple: She dashes away and leaves a Sesshou Sakura that keeps striking enemies with Electro lightning. Up to 3 can be out at once.

abilities.name: Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin
abilities.canon:
Legends of "kitsunetsuki," or the manifestation of a kitsune's might, are common in Inazuma's folktales. One that particularly captures the imagination is that of the Sky Kitsune, said to cause lightning to fall down upon the foes of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Summons a lightning strike, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
When she uses this skill, Yae Miko will unseal nearby Sesshou Sakura, destroying their outer forms and transforming them into Tenko Thunderbolts that descend from the skies, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Each Sesshou Sakura destroyed in this way will create one Tenko Thunderbolt.
abilities.simple: A big Electro strike; each Sesshou Sakura on the field is destroyed for a Tenko Thunderbolt that deals more Electro damage.

abilities.name: The Shrine's Sacred Shade
abilities.canon: When casting Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin, each Sesshou Sakura destroyed resets the cooldown for 1 charge of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura.
abilities.simple: Each Sesshou Sakura her Burst destroys resets the cooldown of 1 Skill charge.

abilities.name: Enlightened Blessing
abilities.canon: Every point of Elemental Mastery Yae Miko possesses will increase Sesshou Sakura DMG by 0.15%.
abilities.simple: Each point of Elemental Mastery raises Sesshou Sakura damage by 0.15%.

abilities.name: Meditations of a Yako
abilities.canon: Has a 25% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is that of the base material.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: Yakan Offering
abilities.canon: Each time Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin activates a Tenko Thunderbolt, Yae Miko will restore 8 Elemental Energy for herself.
abilities.simple: Each Tenko Thunderbolt restores 8 Energy to her.

abilities.name: Fox's Mooncall
abilities.canon: Sesshou Sakura start at Level 2 when created, their max level is increased to 4, and their attack range is increased by 60%.
abilities.simple: Sesshou Sakura start at level 2, go up to level 4 and reach further.

abilities.name: The Seven Glamours
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Sakura Channeling
abilities.canon: When Sesshou Sakura lightning hits opponents, the Electro DMG Bonus of all nearby party members is increased by 20% for 5s.
abilities.razor: Totem hits = Electro up for party.
abilities.simple: When Sesshou Sakura lightning hits, the party gains 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 5s.

abilities.name: Mischievous Teasing
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Forbidden Art: Daisesshou
abilities.canon: The Sesshou Sakura's attacks will ignore 60% of the opponents' DEF.
abilities.simple: Sesshou Sakura attacks ignore 60% of enemy DEF.
